{% set company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company") or "" %} {% set cur = (frappe.db.get_value("Company", company, "default_currency") if company else "AED") or "AED" %} {% set ns = namespace(nxt=none) %} {% for r in doc.payment_schedule %} {% if r.payment_status != "Paid" and ns.nxt is none %}{% set ns.nxt = r %}{% endif %} {% endfor %} {% set days_late = frappe.utils.date_diff(frappe.utils.nowdate(), ns.nxt.due_date) if ns.nxt else 0 %}
{{ company or "Real Estate Developer" }}
Accounts & Collections Department
Ref: {{ doc.name }}-DL
Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()) }}
To: {{ doc.customer }}
Unit: {{ doc.unit }}  |  Project: {{ doc.project }}  |  Tower: {{ doc.tower }}

Subject: Payment Demand – {% if ns.nxt %}{{ ns.nxt.milestone }}{% else %}Statement of Account{% endif %}

Dear {{ doc.customer }},

{% if ns.nxt %}

Thank you for choosing to invest with us. As per the payment plan agreed for your unit {{ doc.unit }} (booking {{ doc.name }} dated {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.booking_date) }}), we request you to settle the following installment {% if days_late > 0 %}which was due on {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(ns.nxt.due_date) }} and is now {{ days_late }} day{{ "s" if days_late != 1 }} overdue{% else %} falling due on {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(ns.nxt.due_date) }}{% endif %}.

Amount Due – {{ ns.nxt.milestone }}
{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(ns.nxt.amount - ns.nxt.paid_amount, currency=cur) }}
Due Date
{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(ns.nxt.due_date) }}
{% else %}

We are pleased to confirm that all installments for your unit {{ doc.unit }} (booking {{ doc.name }}) have been received in full. Please find your statement of account below.

{% endif %}
Net Price
{{ doc.get_formatted("net_price") }}
VAT ({{ doc.vat_percent }}%)
{{ doc.get_formatted("vat_amount") }}
Total Payable
{{ doc.get_formatted("grand_total") }}

Payment Schedule

{% for r in doc.payment_schedule %} {% endfor %}
#MilestoneDue Date% AmountPaidStatus
{{ loop.index }} {{ r.milestone }} {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(r.due_date) }} {{ r.percentage }}% {{ r.get_formatted("amount") }} {{ r.get_formatted("paid_amount") }} {% if r.payment_status == "Paid" %} Paid {% elif r.payment_status == "Partly Paid" %} Partly Paid {% else %} Pending {% endif %}
Total Payable{{ doc.get_formatted("grand_total") }}
Total Received{{ doc.get_formatted("total_paid") }}
Balance Outstanding{{ doc.get_formatted("outstanding") }}
Please make payment by bank transfer, cheque or the payment link shared by our team, quoting reference {{ doc.name }}. Kindly ignore this letter if payment has already been made, and share the transaction details so we can update your account. For any query, contact our collections team.
Yours sincerely,


Accounts Department
{{ company }}
This is a system generated letter and does not require a signature.
name: Demand Letter
